## Topics

The website provides information about physiotherapy services for back and neck pain, joint and sports injuries, rehabilitation after surgery, neurological rehabilitation, exercise therapy, and related assessment services. Individual pages describe available care and service areas.

## Use of health information

Website articles provide general educational information. They are not a diagnosis or a substitute for an individual assessment or medical advice. Seek urgent medical care for severe, sudden, or concerning symptoms.
